$Comment: Gives the Horseman's Reins their right-click where Alec's Tamework runs: held, a right-click opens the player's Horseman's Steed roster (Tamework's TameworkCommand interaction, OpenSelectionMenu, with the Reins' command-item file, Server/Tamework/Items/Commands/Hallows_Eve_Horsemans_Reins.json, named as ConfigId). Patchwork, which Tamework carries, applies this at startup to a generated copy of the Reins' item file and never edits the file itself. The item stays plain everywhere else, because an item naming Tamework's interaction would stop a server without Tamework at boot; When keeps a server that runs Patchwork alone, without Tamework, from adding it too.
